g.text: * Loose emergency land at Z15.4–16.0; no nominal radial contact.
May react misalignment. It does not guarantee zero motor shaft load.
Minimal screw frame • section through actual meshes • 25 October 2026
Gray: frame Orange: rotor/screw Blue: pin (faint = +15 mm) Green: approximate L motor Dark: reused washer
CAD clearance and toolpaths are digital evidence. Physical fit, friction, shaft load and durability remain untested.
